name: creative
description: Skills for structuring image-generation prompts, with an image history (SQLite by default, or Postgres/Supabase directly or through a claude.ai connector), and for rendering motion-graphics videos from code

image_routes.title: Image routes, in order
image_routes.description: Comma-separated route ids to try for images, first one first: codex, gemini, openai, fal (for example codex,gemini). Empty means Claude asks you which route to use

video_routes.title: Video routes, in order
video_routes.description: Comma-separated route ids to try for video, first one first: gemini, fal (for example gemini). Empty means Claude asks you which route to use

sqlite_path.title: Image history SQLite file
sqlite_path.description: Path of the image history's SQLite file (~ is expanded; a relative path is relative to the plugin data directory). Empty means image-history/history.sqlite3 in the plugin data directory, which is deleted when you uninstall the plugin from the last scope unless you pass --keep-data. Ignored when database_url is set

database_url.title: Image history Postgres URL
database_url.description: postgresql://... for Postgres or Supabase. When set, the bundled history MCP server connects here instead of SQLite. Stored in secure storage, not settings.json

route.title: Image history route (saved by Claude)
route.description: Where the image history lives: sqlite or postgres (through the bundled MCP server; postgres needs database_url) or connector (a claude.ai connector that runs SQL). Claude decides and saves this on first use. Empty means not decided yet. When the saved store's setting is missing, the server stops instead of opening another store. Not related to image_routes

connector_id.title: Image history connector (saved by Claude)
connector_id.description: With route=connector: the server part of the connector's tool names, for example the <server> in mcp__<server>__execute_sql

connector_project_id.title: Image history connector project ID (saved by Claude)
connector_project_id.description: With route=connector: the project_id (or similar target ID) the connector's SQL tool needs. Empty if it needs none
